```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 530 - THE GLIDE CLOSED AT ITS ADDRESS (Ground: the standalone log names the fault exactly - the character constructor cannot find the Countess animation blueprint class at the path written in her source, so she falls back to a single node instance that plays one idle pose no matter how she moves, which is the glide his hands report. The assets themselves stand in his project by the thousand under the Countess folder. This job asks the engine registry for every animation blueprint under that folder and prints the true paths, then a gated patcher seats the true class path where the false one stands, and the build runs in the same job with its verdict read from the build log. Every variable carries the p530 prefix.) ==='
$p530fb64 = ''
$p530pb64 = ''
$p530find = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\findabp530.py'
$p530patch = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\Saved\patch530.py'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p530find, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p530fb64))
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p530patch, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p530pb64))
$p530wait = 0
while ((Get-Process -Name 'UnrealEditor-Cmd' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $p530wait -lt 12) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; $p530wait = $p530wait + 1 }
Write-Output ('LOCK WAIT LOOPS=' + $p530wait)
$p530cmd = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealEditor-Cmd.exe'
$p530proc = Start-Process -FilePath $p530cmd -ArgumentList @('"D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject"', '-run=pythonscript', ('-script="' + $p530find + '"'), '-unattended', '-nopause', '-nosplash') -PassThru
$p530poll = 0
while (-not $p530proc.HasExited -and $p530poll -lt 6) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $p530poll = $p530poll + 1 }
Write-Output ('FIND POLLS=' + $p530poll + ' exited=' + $p530proc.HasExited)
& 'C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python.exe' $p530patch
$p530log = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI\build530.log'
& 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat' VEILEditor Win64 Development -Project="D:\VEIL-OMNI\VEIL.uproject" -WaitMutex -NoHotReload *> "$p530log"
$p530res = Select-String -Path $p530log -Pattern 'Result:' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 1
Write-Output ('BUILD ' + $p530res.Line)
Write-Output 'PHI P530 VERDICT: GLIDE SEAT PRINTED ABOVE'
Write-Output 'JOB 530 DONE'
```
